text:
maria_csm: Heads up — Hearthly onboarding showed rising p50 tail-latency on generate (prod) over last 24h, and token cost spiked ~18%. Looking at traces it looks like long instructions + 4k context hits. Thinking proactive recommendation: compact model canary + int8 quant swap + route to reserved pool during peak. Thoughts?
raj_ml: Can you paste the p95/p99 numbers?
maria_csm: p50 120ms -> 220ms, p95 680ms, p99 1200ms. Also their usage pattern: big bursts at 10am UTC and 6pm UTC.
olivia_se: :eyes: budget-wise are they on hosted or dedicated?
maria_csm: Hosted, on free-to-paid trial. Renewal signal medium — worried cost + latency might hurt adoption.
raj_ml: Ok. Quick plan: 1) Canary a compact variant (13B-compact) for non-critical routes. 2) Offer int8 quantized runtime for those canaries. 3) Add routing rule to prefer dedicated reserved pool during bursts (if they commit) or fall back to compact model outside bursts.
maria_csm: Can we give them a one-pager with config + expected savings? They're asking for concrete numbers.
raj_ml: Rough back-of-envelope: int8 -> token cost ~ -30%, compact model latency down p95 ~ 35% for long contexts. Combined could bring their 99th down under 800ms in canary. Will run quick simulation.
olivia_se: I'll draft the enablement checklist and canary runbook. Include rollbacks, traffic split, and eval prompts.
maria_csm: Nice. Customer asks for a safe path — prefer gradual traffic shift. Can we propose this as a phased recommendation?
raj_ml: Phase A: 5% traffic -> 24h eval on latency + quality checks. Phase B: 25% -> 48h with rollback triggers (bleu/qa thresholds + latency SLO). Phase C: full swap if metrics stable.
olivia_se: I'll add automated gating: if embedding/semantic-similarity drop > 3% or p95 increases, cut back.
maria_csm: Can we include a sample routing snippet they can paste?
raj_ml: Here's a minimal routing + model override they can apply in console:```
{
  "route": "hearthly-prod/generate",
  "rules": [
    {"match": "burst_window(09:45-10:15, 17:45-18:15)", "preferred": "reserved-pool-east-1"},
    {"match": "default", "preferred": "open-13b-compact-int8"}
  ],
  "canary": {"traffic_percent": 5, "model": "open-13b-compact-int8"}
}
```
maria_csm: Perfect. Can we also give a CLI snippet for a quick canary set?
raj_ml: Sure:```
# set canary
redwood routes update hearthly-prod/generate --canary-model open-13b-compact-int8 --canary-traffic 5
# enable int8 runtime
redwood models set-execution-profile open-13b-compact-int8 --profile int8
```
olivia_se: I'll attach the canary runbook and quality checklist to the email to Hearthly. Also include suggested prompt tests (5 seed prompts + edge cases).
maria_csm: Customer prefers step-by-step + risk assessment. Can we estimate cost impact for the trial?
raj_ml: For a 5% canary over 24h expecting ~ -25% cost on that slice; negligible overall but shows signal. If they switch 50% -> estimate -20% overall. I'll produce a short table.
maria_csm: Awesome. Can we formalize and send by EOD? I can host a 30m enablement call tomorrow.
olivia_se: Taking action: drafting doc now, will ping when ready.
deploy-bot: Note: route update requires approval if modifying reserved-pool bindings.
raj_ml: Good catch — we'll keep manual gating for reserved pool. For hosted fallback we'll rely on auto-fallback policy.
maria_csm: Thanks team. Once doc ready I'll share with Hearthly and book the call. :thumbsup: Any blockers?
raj_ml: Need a quick sim job on 10k requests — I'll run and post results here within 4h.
olivia_se: No blockers from enablement side.
maria_csm: Closing loop — will post customer acceptance after the call.
